title.narrative: Tripura Urban and Tourism Development Project

description.narrative:
The project will improve the Readiness of Integrated Urban Planning and Infrastructure Development for Urban Local Bodies in Tripura. The main outcome of the project would be: i. Integrated urban infrastructure planning and strategy of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs leading to planned urban development and prioritization of investment projects. ii. Improved readiness of prioritized projects in 7 DHQs and key economic/border trade centers leading to increased external/donor investments in urban infrastructure projects. iii. Faster and more efficient development of urban infrastructure projects, better management of urban assets and better provision of urban services due to strengthened capacity of urban development agencies.
The key activities to be carried out as part of the project would be: i. Urban strategy/investment planning of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs and project prioritization in sectors including urban transport, connectivity among urban centers, electrical connectivity, drinking water, sewerage, septage etc. ii. Feasibility studies, DPRs, detailed engineering designs, safeguards, bidding documents and project preparation support to improve readiness. iii. TA support for institutional strengthening of urban development department and support in PRF activities including developing ToRs for consultants and quality control of PRF outputs.
The key output of the project would be: i. Urban strategy and investment plans for integrated urban infrastructure development of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs completed. ii. Ensuing urban investment projects in 7 DHQs and identified key economic and border trade centers prioritized. iii. Timely completion of feasibility reports, DPRs and other project preparation activities for prioritized urban infrastructure projects. iv. Strengthened capacity of urban development department to plan, design, develop and manage infrastructure assets for the for the proposed 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs.

title.narrative: Loan 6037: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 20 Dec 2024
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53276/53276-001-apfs-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The ensuing loan out of the PRF was split in two phases, first phase Loan-4375 of $ 100 million was signed in November 2023. For the second phase of $ 70 million, the PRF consultants are working on finalizing the documents and DPRs.
All feasibility and DPRs submitted for urban. For tourism, new components have been identified; Feasibility reports and DPRs are in progress for phase 2. The Institutional Review Report and institutional strengthening and capacity development report has been prepared. Capacity building programs have been conducted and will continue until the loan availability period.
Under the Urban component of the project, the report on Urban Strategy and Investment Plans, Prioritization Framework/ Subproject Selection Criteria was finalized.
Under the Tourism component of the project, the report on Tourism Market Analysis and Investment Need Assessment, Tourism Strategy, Action and Investment Plan, and Prioritization Framework/ Subproject Selection were finalized.
